steps.title: Define Project Identity
steps.description: Configure the core app-meta metadata setting the App Name to NoteSphere and package to com.notesphere.app.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Scripts
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with proper Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2 configuration, namespace, SDK version 34, and strict Java 8 compatibility settings.

steps.title: Create Application Manifest
steps.description: Define the AndroidManifest.xml specifying the NoteSphere application, main activity, custom light Material theme, and default launcher settings.

steps.title: Design Database Storage Class
steps.description: Implement NoteDatabaseHelper.java utilizing SQLite to manage structural storage of notes containing titles, contents, categories, and timestamps.

steps.title: Create Main UI Layout
steps.description: Design activity_main.xml featuring high-performance dynamic view groups, an inline search input, category filtering UI, custom note list view, and floating styled action buttons.

steps.title: Design Note List Item Layout
steps.description: Create note_item.xml representing individual notes within the ListView list showing note title, rich preview content, category tag, and visual delete buttons.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Base Lifecycle
steps.description: Establish NoteSphere's primary controller activity loading system layouts, database helpers, and foundational list views.

steps.title: Build Search & Filter Logical Hooks
steps.description: Program key listeners on the filter Spinner and Search Bar input elements to dynamically query the SQLite database on text mutations.

steps.title: Code Add & Edit Form Overlays
steps.description: Integrate interactive dynamic form transitions enabling rapid creation and inline alteration of existing system notes.

steps.title: Implement Delete Action & Alerts
steps.description: Incorporate traditional prompt-based custom dialog confirmations for safe and responsive deletion workflow execution.

steps.title: Validate Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Examine all code points to ensure strict compatibility with Java 8 specifications, checking that only standard anonymous classes are used.

steps.title: Building NoteSphere
steps.description: Execute final build assembly using the localized Gradle daemon verification pipeline to output a stable production-ready debug APK package.
